messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the video's camera setup to a full-body shot from a rear three-quarter angle. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the described camera setup and movement, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, and scene unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to change the video's camera setup to a full-body shot from a rear three-quarter angle. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, and scene unchanged. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The figure stands in an open plaza, turns his head, then places both hands on his hips before lowering his arms and shifting his stance.","camera":"Static medium-long shot from behind and slightly to the side, keeping the figure centered.","clothing":"Dark long-sleeved jacket with a small gold emblem on the back, dark trousers with a light stripe down the side, and dark shoes.","hair_color":"White or very light gray.","hairstyle":"Short, swept-back hair.","identity":"A 3D-rendered male figure with a slim build, shown mostly from behind and in profile.","scene":"A futuristic outdoor plaza with a glossy reflective floor, a domed glass building with glowing green rings on the left, and a tall building with cyan-lit windows on the right."},"uncertain":["Exact facial features are not visible since the figure is mostly seen from behind."]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output reframes the same character from a medium rear view into a wider full-body rear three-quarter view. The opening framing closely matches the reference, with the figure centered and the domed glass building visible on the left. The character's head turn, hands-on-hips pose, and arm lowering occur in a similar sequence and timing. The character's white hair, dark jacket, and dark trousers remain consistent.
arguments.requested_change: Change the camera to a full-body rear three-quarter shot, using the reference image for initial viewing direction, subject placement, and framing, while preserving the person's identity, appearance, clothing, action timing, and scene.
uncertain: Whether the scene change was intended as part of the reference-based camera setup or is an unintended scene alteration.
unexpected_changes: The scene composition changed more than a pure camera reframe: the output shows a domed glass building and different surrounding architecture on the left, while the source showed a large flat building facade and different background structures.
